views.name: director_movie_links
views.body_sql: SELECT dm.name_id AS director_id, n.name AS director_name, m.duration AS movie_duration, r.avg_rating AS rating, r.total_votes AS votes, m.date_published AS release_date FROM director_mapping dm JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
views.description: links each director to their directed movies, providing director identifiers, movie duration, rating, vote count, and release date for temporal ordering

views.name: director_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  director_id,
  director_name,
  COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
  AVG(diff_days) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
  AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
  SUM(votes) AS total_votes,
  MIN(rating) AS min_rating,
  MAX(rating) AS max_rating,
  SUM(movie_duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    movie_duration,
    rating,
    votes,
    release_date,
    CAST(julianday(release_date) - julianday(LAG(release_date) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY release_date)) AS INTEGER) AS diff_days
  FROM director_movie_links
)
GROUP BY director_id, director_name
views.description: computes per-director statistics including movie count, rating metrics, vote totals, duration sums, and average inter-movie duration derived from ordered release dates
